landmarks.what: lenient Bash-line scanner: chained commands, prefix stripping, cd/git -C dirs, heredoc-safe substitutions, final fd1/fd2 destinations, Partial on unreadable input

commit-green admits a git commit (cd/-C tracked, chained git adds replayed, -a honoured) only when its candidate tree equals the recorded full green; .dross-only commits and repos with no tests pass; unjudgeable forms and unpredictable predecessors refuse; a diverged candidate names the paths to stage or clean

dross gate check (PreToolUse: exit 2 with the refusal printed once, silent exit 0 on allow, any non-verdict failure incl. panics is exit 0 + one warning) and dross gate record (PostToolUse, never blocks); both skip telemetry

dross execute begin <phase> [--solo] records the run's mode in .dross/gate/execute.json (only after the phase has a plan.toml); a same-mode re-run leaves it byte-identical and state.json is never touched

~/.claude/dross/gate-overrides.json holds human lifts (workflow gates per repo key, secret gates machine-wide) with expiry, written atomically, corrupt lifts nothing; tamper-guard (unliftable, always-on) refuses tool writes to .dross/gate records and the store via file tools, redirects, tee, cp, mv

dross hooks ensure / init / onboard idempotently wire matcher-less PreToolUse (dross gate check) and PostToolUse (dross gate record) beside PreCompact/SessionStart via MergeHook, writing settings.json atomically with its mode kept (0600 when new)

doctor Hooks section over the effective user settings.json: a missing gate hook, a gate command only under a matcher, disableAllHooks or an unreadable file is an issue (non-zero exit); missing PreCompact/SessionStart only warns

a bare dross test in a lanes-only repo (no runtime.test_command) runs every declared lane unscoped through runPlannedLanes — per-lane grant, prepare, toolchain, locality, worst-wins — instead of refusing at the whole-suite consent gate

tree-object fingerprints from a scratch byte copy of the git index (GIT_INDEX_FILE): WorkingTree as git add -A would stage, Candidate with earlier git adds and -a replayed, .dross/ excluded; real index never touched

hook-payload gate engine: registered gates (always-on vs workflow scope, liftable, list-extensible) judged with per-gate panic recovery, closed in-domain, unparseable payload allowed with a warning; read-only dross root locator; defaults unioned with additive gates.toml

machine-local .dross/gate/ records (green tree, execute mode, task approval) behind a self-ignoring .gitignore; atomic temp+rename writes; corrupt = error naming the path; a git-tracked record refused unread

ship's ARCHITECTURE.md commit and init's initial commit run a bare dross test first so the commit gate sees a recorded green; no prompt tells the agent to lift a gate (TestNoPromptTellsAgentToLiftGate)
resume prunes handoff.md in place with Edit and pause creates it with Write but updates an existing one with Edit, so neither routine flow trips the curated-shrink gate

always-on secret-stream refuses a secret-emitting tool unless stdout and stderr both leave the transcript; secret-read refuses Read or cat/head/tail/less/sed of secret path patterns (env templates exempt); gate-off-guard (unliftable) refuses dross gate off/check/record through the agent's Bash

workflow gates: plan-edit refuses Edit/MultiEdit of an existing plan.toml (dross task add/edit/move/remove) and a Write over one once any task left pending; curated-shrink refuses a Write cutting a curated .dross file below half its size (use Edit)

a full dross test (bare test_command, lanes-only every-lane, or lane-less --files) fingerprints the tree before and after and records .dross/gate/green.json only for an unchanged green tree; red on that tree clears it, never-ran exits leave it, recorder failures only warn
